snippet.title: I made a creepy WarioWare-like game: Portaboy+
snippet.description:
Portaboy+ is a fun, simple, c̸̡̺̤̤̩̻̳̭̫̜̟̦͒̽͋̍̅̚u̸̜̬̗̇͊̈̓̆́̌̚͘r̸̡̹̭̦̦͔̭̭͛̇͂͗̋s̸̢̱̺͕͕̯͍̦͎̞̥̪͍̓͆̈͌͌͆̕ȅ̷̼̝̰͕̗̰̻͖̼̞͓̤̱́̈́̌̈́̈͝͝d̷̡̤̙̬̗̯͍͓͙͛; FREE WarioWare-like browser game. Just in time for Halloween! 
Itch link: https://enchae.itch.io/portaboyplus
Newgrounds link: https://www.newgrounds.com/portal/view/860557

Portaboy+ is a remastered version of Portaboy, which was a game I made for Ludum Dare 41. With 6 little minigames to master, what's the highest score you can get? Keep playing! Stay concentrating! There's no end... no escape... right?

Portaboy+ features art by yours truly,
Coding by Enchae. Twitter: https://twitter.com/EnchaeC
Music by b-knox. Twitter: https://twitter.com/b_knox

I can't wait to see you all play Portaboy+! If you end up playing the game tag me or shoot me a link on Twitter. https://twitter.com/LumpyTouch

If you end up asking other YouTubers to play this game, please do so respectfully!
